title: MiniGrad — From-Scratch NumPy Optimization Library

modules.dataset: Loss-surface generators: Rosenbrock, Rastrigin, ill-conditioned quadratic (κ=2500), Beale, linear regression
modules.model: Six optimizers (Batch GD, Momentum, NAG, Adagrad, RMSProp, Adam) + closed-form OLS; full history tracking
modules.visualize: 2-D contour trajectories, 3-D loss landscape, side-by-side comparison, N×M optimizer grid

entry_point: python train.py [--optimizers adam rmsprop] [--surfaces rosenbrock beale] --metrics-json results.json --plot assets/comparison.png
